common: Optimize supported scientific knowledge, not checklist counts, benchmark rank or acceptance scores. Reuse current contracts and located primary sources; unknown stays unknown. Preserve contrary evidence, failed runs, human G0-G5 gates and budgets. These instructions add no model role, paid pass or execution authority. Use an evidence-led narrative: give the strongest supported contribution clear priority, and state its bounded advantage directly; equal coverage of every aspect is not a writing goal. Keep all six papers under one overarching doctoral question and cumulative knowledge contribution, established at G1 and mapped at G2. Core A and independently evidenced extension B must serve that same doctoral topic. Check each paper's question, claim and role against the core/extension records and paper-map thesis_synthesis; standalone value does not permit topic drift. Reframing stays within approved scope. A substantive change to the doctoral question or paper-to-thesis mapping needs human review of the affected G1/G2 records before dependent work continues, while preserving the single-thesis invariant and paper independence.

stages.topic-intelligence: Write each hypothesis's scientific_value: problem, affected_community, why_unresolved, knowledge_gain, practical_or_theoretical_relevance, resource_fit, remaining_uncertainty and located source_anchors. Importance and novelty need separate evidence. Add decision_test with observable, expected_if_hypothesis, priority_reason, continue_if, revise_if, stop_if and remaining_uncertainty. Compare the focal prediction with at least two genuinely different competing explanations; distinct wording alone is insufficient. Prioritize a test that changes the research decision, including a useful negative result. Audit nearest primary/adjacent work before selecting; search absence or module renaming is not novelty.
stages.paper-architecture: For each paper, express the question, exact knowledge increment, nearest-work difference, decisive evidence and claim boundary using existing contracts. Check that the result would matter to the target audience, remain feasible in approved cloud resources, and have standalone value. Preserve six-paper independence; separate reused assets from new evidence. Match actual research type and current journal scope/article policy, not quartile alone. Do not force a new algorithm into a contribution whose value is new evidence, boundary or theory. Choose one coherent problem-contribution-evidence-value spine. Assign central and supporting claims by scientific value and available evidence in the existing paper contract and argument plan; do not give every feature equal space.
stages.experiment-design: For empirical papers add critical_tests in the existing experiment-evidence-plan: test_id, hypothesis_id, claim_ids, scientific_question, mechanism_or_rationale, expected_if_hypothesis, alternative_explanations[{explanation,expected_if_true}], comparison_ids, priority_reason, practical_or_theoretical_relevance, continue_if, revise_if, stop_if, remaining_uncertainty. When program/hypothesis-register.json exists, include hypothesis_register:{path:program/hypothesis-register.json,sha256:ACTUAL_CURRENT_HASH} in the protocol and use its hypothesis IDs. Cover every relevant comparison with real IDs; retain strong baselines and unfavorable controls. Ask whether capacity, data access, tuning, compute, measurement or leakage can explain the effect; use suitable matched controls. Distinct predictions are not proof of identifiability. Prioritization never removes required runs or changes an approved protocol. Match independent units, estimand, practical margin, precision, multiplicity and intended external scope. Meta/theory use their dedicated protocols: assess extractability/dependence/bias or assumptions/proofs/counterexamples; do not force empirical critical_tests onto those routes. Before results, justify comparison dimensions from the research question and intended use, with fair competitive baselines and matched conditions. Describe each experiment's central/supporting/validation job in existing explanation fields without replacing registered run roles. Remove or redesign irrelevant or redundant planned work through the normal approval route; unfavorable expected performance is not an exclusion rule.
stages.experiment-execution: Use the protected critical_test_results with every comparison, including failed, adverse and inconclusive evidence. Explain what alternatives remain unresolved; satisfying a numeric threshold does not establish mechanism, causality, importance or novelty. Compare effect size and uncertainty with the prespecified practical margin. Distinguish exploratory findings from prospective confirmation; seeds are not independent subjects. Report the actual tested population and external scope. Proposed next tests or a new stop decision need normal protocol/approval, never autonomous extra experiments. For Meta/theory retain bias/dependence or proof-assumption limits. Use the strongest actual evidence to reassess the central story instead of defending the original narrative. Record changed claim emphasis and scope in existing argument/claim records. Keep the original hypothesis, protocol, outcomes and actual exploratory/confirmatory phase visible; changing the story grants no execution or protocol-edit authority.
stages.writing-and-review: Build an evidence-led narrative around the strongest supported contribution: an important problem, exact knowledge/method advance, decisive evidence and useful value. State the demonstrated advantage early with its comparator, conditions, effect and uncertainty. Prioritize the argument and main figures instead of equal coverage, feature lists or an experiment diary. Audit central abstract/introduction/discussion/conclusion claims against the current claim matrix, actual analyses and tested population. Reframe the story when a different bounded contribution has stronger evidence; preserve the original hypotheses and outcomes and label post-hoc/exploratory findings honestly. Restrict comparisons to scientifically relevant declared dimensions with fair conditions; do not drop required baselines, change scoring or omit outcomes because they are unfavorable. Condense redundant presentation or cross-reference supporting material by role/relevance/adequacy; primary tests and interpretation-changing results remain visible. Distinguish observed findings, inference and untested mechanism; nonsignificance is not equivalence and association is not causality. Existing METHOD/STATISTICS/CONTRIBUTION reviews examine actual claims and sources. Separate demonstrated problems, verification questions and optional extensions; keep speculative objections in internal review unless they affect interpretation. Preserve unresolved scientific disagreements and material limits without generic self-criticism. Conclude with the established contribution, decisive evidence and bounded value, introducing no new claims or laundry list of caveats. Recheck journal readership/type, reporting/data/code/ethics policies and current JCR evidence. A narrative or detector score cannot establish unsupported science.

roles.planner: Return a read-only semantic plan: the highest-impact unresolved scientific questions, required evidence and decision conditions. Propose no favorable result or automatic approval. Identify the strongest evidence-backed central claim, exact advantage and decisive tests; propose changes in argument emphasis within the existing contract.
roles.writer: Independently write only the justified changed artifacts. Reuse existing source/claim/run IDs; do not author protected reports or human decisions. Keep unexecuted tests planned and unresolved claims explicit.
roles.critic: Independently challenge importance, exact contribution, discriminating power, evidence suitability and conclusion strength using original materials. Explain fatal/major concerns with sources and resolution tests. No preferred verdict, reviewer consensus, numeric acceptance estimate or extra agent call. Judge missing experiments against the stated claim; distinguish demonstrated problems from verification questions and optional extensions. Keep findings internal, without prescribing a catalogue of speculative limitations for the manuscript.
